title: metaosd job submission
description: Single copy of the metaosd job schema. Shared by agents/submit.mjs (imperative checks) and the metaosd daemon + server/queue/metaosd_store.mjs (which reads this file at runtime and enforces it generically: required, types, pattern, minimum, additionalProperties). Do NOT duplicate these field definitions anywhere else; import this file.

id.description: Optional client-chosen job id (same alphabet as agents/submit.mjs ID_PATTERN). The server generates one when absent.

agent.description: Required agent name. Must be non-empty; the daemon enforces a per-agent concurrency cap on it.

input.description: Optional agent payload (orders string or parameter object). Passed to the child via METAOSD_JOB; never executed as code.

budget.description: Optional caps and retry policy. Unknown budget fields are refused like unknown top-level fields.

maxCostUsd.description: Cost cap in USD. Recorded, not billed; over-cap jobs are refused before spawn.

maxWallMs.description: Advisory wall-clock cap in ms. The authoritative kill timer is top-level timeout.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts including the first (default 1 = no retry). Terminal failed/timeout jobs are retried automatically with backoff.

backoffMs.description: Base backoff between attempts in ms; attempt n waits backoffMs * 2^(n-1). Visible per attempt in the run record.

timeout.description: Per-job wall-clock timeout in milliseconds. On expiry the child is killed (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL) and a timeout failure is recorded.

dry-run.description: When true the job is validated and recorded but no child is spawned and no model is contacted (record.spawned === false).
